Ambra Anton yes I understood and it is indeed not enough as that letter is not an actual invitation letter. Based on risk assessment, they will require in many cases an invitation which means you need to apply via the immigration office let them know jn advance and they will issue to approval. It is pretty streamlined when done via the branch but many skip this part and then relatives end up being sent. 

I am so sorry this has happened to you, sound confusing and frustrating beyond words. I am sure that if you'll speak to the Misrad Hapnim branch you'll be able to solve this for future visits.
